dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge displays a deep concave curvature with a primary notch near the posterior base and secondary irregular serrations along the lower half.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow rounded pixel radius at the peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, continuous convex slope from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.2 times the vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple notches of varying depths on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; cluster of dark, irregular markings/lesions on the lateral flank ventral to the fin; faint linear striae on the fin's mid-section.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced V-shaped notch situated approximately 25% up the trailing edge from the posterior insertion.
